scope: Bounded reconciliation cutoff and immutable selection reuse fix discovered by the Stage 4 infrastructure matrix; no model-quality or human-pilot conclusion.

resolved_findings.finding: Arithmetic next-root minus one manufactured an empty interval across valid sparse sequence coordinates.
resolved_findings.resolution: The lookup uses an actual selected predecessor coordinate.

resolved_findings.finding: A root predating activation can have only late selected members after the next root, leaving no selected predecessor; falling back to the highest selected sequence could include a still newer unrelated root.
resolved_findings.resolution: Absent selected predecessor uses the known last discovered root member, separately from absent-next-root handling.

resolved_findings.finding: A selected predecessor may belong to an earlier root whose late members arrived after an already sealed current root.
resolved_findings.red_evidence: TestPilotSealedRootDoesNotOwnLateMembersOfEarlierRoot failed before the membership reuse guard in 0.280s, creating failed zero-attempt interval5..6 with no new current-root members.
resolved_findings.resolution: Discovery already covered by the referenced immutable selection reuses that interval; only a discovered root member beyond sealedLast keeps the root pending.

resolved_findings.finding: An absent predecessor search could walk pre-activation retained events before rejecting them by commit position.
resolved_findings.resolution: The new predecessor query starts at the last discovered selected root member; this is equivalent under the existing maximum guard.

review_conclusions: Predecessor lookup retains exact session and activation append-position lower/upper bounds.
Actual later root closure is still evaluated independently by source capture without importing later root text.
The existing max(last) guard retains legitimate late root members.
nextCompilerInterval still starts from the activation first coordinate and finds earliest unowned ranges around immutable historical ownership.
Pending unmaterialized selection reuse and queue-capacity revisit behavior are retained.
The last-versus-sealedLast comparison preserves known actual remainder obligations without creating obligations from foreign coordinates.
No new authority, schema, dependency, scheduling lane, or automatic historical selection is introduced.

verification.cases: Contiguous and sparse reconsideration; live-prefix closure and late same-root member; pre-frontier root with late selected children; late members of an earlier root.

verification.note: Independent focused interval, activation-frontier, closure, queue, source-bound and history regression checks.

verification.reason: Assigned bounded independent review; implementation owner/root retains full frozen-tree verification responsibility.

reviewer_edits: Added TestPilotPreFrontierRootLateMembersDoNotOwnNewerRoot and TestPilotSealedRootDoesNotOwnLateMembersOfEarlierRoot to the assigned regression test file. Production changes were made by the implementation owner.
